2609.14425.title: Has Scientific Talent Shifted from Depth to Breadth?Evidence across Papers, Knowledge Inputs, Careers, and Teams
2609.14425.paper_summary: Generative artificial intelligence raises a central question for scientific training and organization. Is research shifting from deep specialization toward broad individual knowledge? We examine this proposition across papers, cited knowledge, contributor histories, and teams using 47,959 articles from six fields over 2010-2025, 51,736 resolved cited works, and chronologically reconstructed prior publication histories for 1,754 randomly selected index contributors. From 2010 to 2022, team size increased by an estimated 37.3% (95% confidence interval [34.4%, 40.3%]), while paper topic breadth declined by 0.0144 on a 0-1 hierarchical distance scale. Cited knowledge was stable to modestly broader, revealing a divergence between focused outputs and the reach of knowledge inputs. Established contributors' prior breadth increased by 0.0190 [-0.0078, 0.0459] by 2019-2022, within a +/-0.05 equivalence bound assessed in sensitivity analysis. In mature citation windows, one standard deviation of focal depth was associated with 8.2% higher 1 + FWCI [1.9%, 14.9%]; average breadth and interaction associations were smaller under the specified equivalence bounds. Post-2022 deviations from earlier trends were not systematic, and recent changes did not vary clearly with baseline AI intensity across 83 subfields. The findings support a differentiated structure of scientific expertise in which focused individual accumulation coexists with expanding collaboration and sustained access to diverse knowledge inputs.
2609.14425.paper_summary_zh: 生成式人工智慧為科學訓練和組織提出了一個核心問題。研究是否正在從深度專業化轉向廣泛的個人知識？我們通過分析2010年至2025年六個領域的47,959篇文章、51,736個已解決的引用作品以及對1,754名隨機選擇的索引貢獻者的歷史出版記錄進行了這一命題的檢視。從2010年到2022年，團隊規模估計增加了37.3%（95%置信區間[34.4%, 40.3%]），而論文主題的廣度在0-1的階層距離尺度上下降了0.0144。引用的知識保持穩定或略有擴大，顯示出專注的產出與知識輸入的範圍之間的差異。已建立貢獻者的先前廣度在2019-2022年期間增加了0.0190 [-0.0078, 0.0459]，在敏感性分析中評估的 +/-0.05 等價範圍內。在成熟的引用窗口中，焦點深度的一個標準差與8.2%的1 + FWCI [1.9%, 14.9%]相關；在指定的等價範圍內，平均廣度和互動關聯較小。2022年後的偏差並不系統，最近的變化在83個子領域中與基線AI強度並未明顯變化。這些發現支持了一種差異化的科學專業結構，其中專注的個人積累與擴大的合作和持續獲取多樣化知識輸入共存。
